title: Full environment workflow — segmentation, image-to-3D, retopo, baking, scene assembly — all inside one editor
author: Pradyumgg
selftext:
Documenting this because I rarely see full end-to-end 3D workflows shown in one place without jumping between tools.

Started with a few reference images and completed the entire thing without leaving the editor once:

1. Segmented the reference image to isolate individual objects
2. Extracted the bed as a separate element
3. Image-to-3D to get a base mesh
4. Retopology pass
5. Baked high poly to low poly — albedo and normal maps
6. Scene assembly using the reference as a guide

The editor also has an agent built in so parts of this were executed through prompts directly inside the same workspace rather than manually triggering each step separately.

Happy to answer questions about any specific step in the pipeline.

comments.author: Emergency-Leopard-24
comments.body: What app is used for this workflow?

replies.author: Pradyumgg
replies.body: It goes by the name of Mixar. We've been building this with the focus on keeping the creative control with the artists while helping them with the grunt work. Let me know if you'd like to try it out. Would be happy to hook you with the access.

comments.author: LittleYo
comments.body: Which model do you use to power it up?

replies.author: Pradyumgg
replies.body: Our agent is powered using claude and gemini. for image to 3d we have hunyuan, rodin, tripo and sam3d.

comments.author: M4xs0n
comments.body: Do you know the YouTube stefan 3D AI lab? He shows latest tools for 3d modelling etc. but like you already said, he mostly uses multiple tools. How does this method compare to his approach?

replies.author: Pradyumgg
replies.body:
Yeah Stefan's work is great, he shows what's possible but the constant jumping between tools adds up. 

What we've built is the same pipeline but entirely inside one editor. Segmentation, image-to-3D, baking, scene assembly, and everything else — the agent ties it all together natively. No switching, no exporting, just one workspace.

comments.author: Square-Yam-3772
comments.body: This is some high level stuff. Nice

replies.author: Pradyumgg
replies.body: Thanks man, we've been building this for a while now, ensuring that we keep in mind the artist's perspective towards AI and how it can empower them instead of taking away their job.
